method:
Build results/bench/replay.json from bench/replay/out/runs.jsonl (replay runs), out/lists-*.json (recorded top-k
lists), out/exact.json (numpy exact lists) and out/env.json (hardware, limits, notes written by run_all.sh).

Breakdown per search (all ms, additive; the means add up to the mean total):
  compute          the recorded in-memory ranker time, burned on the main thread (pre + post)
  encode           worker compute for the query's texts (one batch per model)
  encode_queue     wait in the encoder worker behind other searches
  qdrant / crate   per store, the client-observed request time on the critical path of each stage, incl. the
                   injected RTT (stage 1 is max(encode + Qdrant, Crate) since Crate starts at once). Split into
                   _server (Qdrant `time`, Crate `duration`), _rtt and _transfer (the rest: request/response JSON
                   on both ends, HTTP, and the event loop picking up the response; Qdrant's `time` excludes its own
                   request parsing and response serialization)
  display          the final 50-title payload fetch (Qdrant retrieve), incl. RTT
  other            the rest: event-loop waits behind other searches' CPU work, request building, mixing
Production scaling: CPU work (everything except the injected RTT) times f, RTT unchanged.

environment.machine: AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D (16 cores / 32 threads), shared workstation: another session ran a CPU backfill benchmark pinned to CPUs 8-15 during these runs, plus desktop apps
environment.node: v26.9.0 (production: Node 24.10; the replay uses Node's built-in TypeScript type stripping)
environment.clients: @qdrant/js-client-rest 1.19.0 (REST, QdrantClient as d4.server.ts, api().queryBatchPoints / getPoints / queryPoints so Qdrant's `time` is visible), undici 6.21.3 fetch POST /_sql with Basic auth (as catalog.server.ts)

limits.crate: docker update --cpus 4 --cpuset-cpus 20-23 (SMT siblings of Qdrant's cores; CPUs 8-15/24-31 were busy with another benchmark)
limits.restored: --cpus 32 --cpuset-cpus 0-31 (docker cannot unset --cpus in place; 32 = every CPU = no limit)

network.how: setTimeout before every request (1 ms granularity: rounded to 2 and 3 ms; actual measured delay recorded per request, about 2.1 / 3.1 ms)
network.not_modelled: bandwidth: score_ids responses are about 190 KB per batch and the non-English exact mix about 5 MB; at 1 Gbit/s that adds about 1.5 ms and 40 ms in production

environment.encoder: worker thread, fp32 onnxruntime-node, bge-base-en-v1.5 + multilingual-e5-small, 4 intra-op threads, one batch per model per search, requests served one at a time
environment.compute: trace timing_ms.memory (Python, warm) burned as a busy loop on the main thread: spell + resolve_reference + fuzzy_title before the stores, the rest after the last stage
environment.cpu_scaling: production Xeon Skylake (webapp 8 vCPU; Qdrant 16 vCPU @2.0 GHz) assumed 2x to 3x slower per core than this Ryzen; not measured on production (read-only access does not allow benchmarks). Estimate = (search time - injected RTT on the critical path) x factor + RTT. Local single-thread reference: bge-base fp32 one short query at 4 threads 7.9 ms, at 2 threads 11.2 ms (results/bench/encoders.json)
environment.jev_reading: not part of the replay. Production p50 end to end: 688 ms with a cached reading, 1,750 ms with a fresh one; the fresh reading's extra time is estimated as the difference, about 1,060 ms

media_fingerprint_v1_f16.method: PUT /collections/{c}/vectors/fingerprint_raw (create named vector on the existing collection), then PUT /points/vectors

media_fingerprint_v1_f32.method: PUT /collections/{c}/vectors/fingerprint_raw (create named vector on the existing collection), then PUT /points/vectors

media_fingerprint_v1_sq8.method: PUT /collections/{c}/vectors/fingerprint_raw (create named vector on the existing collection), then PUT /points/vectors

production_reference.note: production end to end (Crate search_history.elapsed_ms, 2026-09-21..23): includes language prep, the Jev stage, title lookup, d4 retrieval, metadata and blend. The fresh reading's extra time is estimated as fresh p50 - cached p50.

headline.recommended_config: f16, raw undici fetch for Qdrant batches, fingerprint_raw top-k exact, non-English mix as two top-2000 lists + one rescore round trip with precomputed per-filter stats, precomputed reference profiles (lookup_from), Crate one UNION ALL statement per stage
